title: L-shaped bracket with a sharp re-entrant corner (plane stress, singular stress)
description:
Aluminium L-shaped bracket, plane stress. The inner (re-entrant) corner is sharp (no fillet).
Geometry (STEP, planar face in the xy-plane): the union of a vertical leg [0, 0.04] x [0, 0.12] m and a horizontal leg [0, 0.12] x [0, 0.04] m. Vertices (0, 0), (0.12, 0), (0.12, 0.04), (0.04, 0.04), (0.04, 0.12), (0, 0.12); the re-entrant corner is at (0.04, 0.04). Thickness 0.002 m.
Material: linear elastic, E = 7e+10 Pa, nu = 0.33.
Supports: the top end of the vertical leg, y = 0.12 m (0 <= x <= 0.04), is fully clamped.
Loads: total force F = 200 N in the -y direction, uniformly distributed over the free end of the horizontal leg, x = 0.12 m (0 <= y <= 0.04). All other edges are free.
Report (SI units):
  vm_max         maximum von Mises stress [Pa]
  tip_uy         u_y at the middle of the loaded end, (0.12, 0.02) [m]
  strain_energy  total strain energy (given thickness) [J]
